response.sql: WITH qc_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(qc_count)::float as total_qc, COUNT(*)::float as project_count FROM qc_counts), stats AS (SELECT qc_counts.arcref, qc_counts.qc_count, qc_counts.qc_count::float / totals.total_qc as share, (qc_counts.qc_count::float / totals.total_qc) - (1.0 / totals.project_count) as deviation FROM qc_counts CROSS JOIN totals) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM stats ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
